$description: Envision Design System — TIER 2 BRAND (theme seam). This is the ONLY layer a white-label builder overrides. Branded-house architecture: shared foundations + shared components, controlled brand overrides. Adding a new builder = add a new MODE to this collection (e.g. 'westlake', 'builder-b'), NOT a new design system. Default mode = 'westlake' (the audited product). Semantic color aliases point here for brand-tinted roles so a single mode swap re-themes the whole system. CSS prefix: --envision-t2-brand-<path>.

primary.$description: Builder primary. Default = Envision green. Only this ramp + accent are expected to change per builder (Coke/Diet-Coke branded-house model from the methodology).

accent.$description: Secondary brand accent (notification badge). Default = orange.

on-primary.$description: Content color that sits on primary surfaces. Must pass contrast against primary/500.

font.$description: Brand fonts. UI font is shared (Inter) and NOT part of the brand seam; only the display face changes per builder.
